{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
The '''Intellidor 8 droid brain''' was a type of advanced [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] that was installed on the [[AC series pilot droid]]s used by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] company<ref name="STII">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref> sometime between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="SWArchive-Disney Unveils New Star Tours Droids">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/startours_droids/index.html|text=Disney Unveils New Star Tours Droids}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Although the Intellidor 8 droid brain was not mentioned verbally during the ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' ride, it was mentioned in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on a computer graphic describing the characteristics of the AC Series.<ref name="STII" />
